responsibilities.visualScroll: Private300ms/quartOut policy retained. Replace uncancellable b-tween wrapper with owned original-window RAF and internal cancellation/caller-availability predicate; consume each frame once and recheck after scrolling.
responsibilities.reducedMotion: Check current target-owner preference on initial entry/every frame. Immediate target when reduced; enabling during animation finishes next frame. Controlled preference mock, not OS setting.
responsibilities.measurement: Owner-window RAF coalesces original container listener; binding/frame/operation generations reject old, duplicate and geometry-reentrant work.
responsibilities.notification: Post-render nextTick change is state sequencing, not CSS duration; invalidate/consume delivery, preserving current same-hash pending notification.
responsibilities.cleanup: Replace click/deactivate/dispose/container-or-boundary change cancels frame/task and removes original listeners. Cancel stops without jump/finish; activation binds/measures, no old animation resume.
responsibilities.registration: AnchorLink watch cleanup removes original href/node on replacement/disposal. Parent identity check protects newer same-hash node. Unregistering current link invalidates work and remeasures.
responsibilities.unchanged: Public Props/Events, CSS variables/colors and default scroll duration/easing unchanged. Shared throttleByRaf, other b-tween consumers and package dependency untouched. Maple has no Anchor runtime.

verification.compositionBoundary: Actual Anchor/AnchorLink/private slide under JSDOM. Mock compute-scroll geometry, owner RAF and reduced media; test immediate scroll releases consumer gating and subsequent viewport measurement still selects. Not real native layout/OS/paint.

coverage.scope: Runtime candidate classification; merge same-name public top-level source directories, exclude underscore infrastructure and utils. Not all-library acceptance or count of defects.
coverage.denominatorChange: Close the two original pending Anchor hints; new owned measurement RAF and slide RAF/preference expose3 new implementation hints, all classified. Do not claim5 old hints were closed or new code is extra defects.
coverage.refreshScope: Only reviewed Anchor runtime rows/new private helper candidate and hashes. Other26 CSS/date drifts preserved.
coverage.standingReportingRule: Every batch reports closed/total, pending family count/percent and hint counts with denominator changes; distinguish classification from browser/OS acceptance.

boundaries: Controlled RAF/clock/geometry and current preference mocks do not certify actual fonts/layout/scroll painting or OS setting.
